key_insight: OpenPVMapper combines multiple complementary sources to build the first open, nationwide installation-level database of rooftop PV systems in mainland France.
engineering_relevance: The dataset enables better grid planning, asset monitoring, and large-scale PV analysis by providing georeferenced rooftop PV locations with provenance and validation metadata.
method: Deep-learning detection on nationwide aerial imagery
Integration with OpenStreetMap and a probabilistic building-level detection dataset
Source reconciliation with provenance tracking and manual validation flags
evidence_signal: The database includes 1,135,850 installations totaling about 15.01 GWp, and a stratified manual review of 1,862 installations estimates overall precision at roughly 74–75% with gains from cross-source corroboration.
watch_item: Precision is still imperfect, so downstream studies should account for false positives, source overlap, and any bias introduced by uneven validation coverage.
paper_title: OpenPVMapper: A Multi-source, Nationwide Database of Rooftop Photovoltaic Systems in France
